# LMKG - Large-scale Medical Knowledge Graph

Paper: "LMKG: A large-scale and multi-source medical knowledge graph for intelligent medicine applications"
(Peiru Yang et al., Knowledge-Based Systems, 2024, DOI: 10.1016/j.knosys.2023.111323)

## Dataset Info
- 403,784 entities (13 types: Disease, Drug, Symptom, Gene, Protein, Species, etc.)
- 1,225,097 relations (17 types: cause, treat, interact, etc.)
- Multi-source, multi-lingual medical knowledge graph
